title: The Gilded Sigil Again
author: Emrys Montrose
blurb: Ada Winterbourne, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
